# Color Hex

> > A comprehensive color reference platform providing hex codes, RGB values, and community-created color palettes for designers and developers.

Color Hex offers an extensive database of color information including hex codes, RGB values, and color schemes. The site features thousands of user-generated color palettes inspired by various themes from pop culture characters (Hatsune Miku, Disney) to design aesthetics (gradients, neutrals), serving as a practical resource for web designers, graphic artists, and developers.

## Key Topics

- hex color codes
- RGB values
- color palettes
- gradient palettes
- grey color schemes
- neutral colors
- user-generated palettes
- community color collections
- design resources
- color schemes
- pastel colors
- character-inspired palettes
- monochromatic palettes
- color theory
- web design colors

## Color Palette Collections

- [Grey Color Palettes](https://www.color-hex.com/grey-color-palettes): Community-created grey color palettes with hex codes for design projects
- [Gradient Color Palettes](https://www.color-hex.com/gradient-color-palettes): User-generated gradient color palettes collection with hex codes
